purpose: Name market-adjacent coding-agent baselines for future same-task, same-environment measurement without implying that a run or result already exists.
executionRequirements: Use the identical task IDs and prompt bytes for every included tool.
Use one recorded environment and hardware profile for the entire comparison group.
Record the installed tool version, model identity, tool-specific configuration, execution date, and raw public artifacts.
Report task completion, quality, latency, tool-use success, failure modes, reproducibility, and resource or cost measures when available.
Keep missing runs and missing metrics as NOT_MEASURED or unknown; never coerce them to zero.
Do not publish a comparative figure until at least two completed runs pass the scorecard comparability gate.
